text:
Maya R: rolled out `enable_flashattn_v2` to gpu-pool-us-west at 02:15 UTC. seeing customer-reported p99 spikes on long-seq chat (>4k tokens). can anyone triage? :eyes:

Alex P: on it. grabbing graphs now — looks like p99 for rwd-7b-long jumped from ~320ms -> 1.2s around 02:18. p95 also up but less severe. link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/rt/serve?panelId=12&from=now-30m

Sam K: which variant was selected? we changed kernel selection heuristics in the compileflag rollout last night (`-Oattn=flash_opt`).

Maya R: yes, compile flag `-Oattn=flash_opt` + heuristic to prefer FlashAttention on seq>=2048. rollout ID `rollout/2026-03-flashopt`.

Alex P: logs from runtime show increased fallback churn: many kernels failing with `CUBLAS_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR` then falling back to slower path. sample:
```
2026-03-15T02:18:23Z WARN kernel_select: selected flashattn_v2
2026-03-15T02:18:23Z ERROR kernel_launch: flashattn_v2 failed: CUBLAS_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR
2026-03-15T02:18:23Z INFO kernel_launch: falling back to sdpa_generic (higher latency)
```

Sam K: repro on a local dev box (A100) with seq=4096, batch=1, model=rwd-7b-long. command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-long","input":"<long chat>","max_tokens":512}'
```
I see time-to-first-byte jump consistent with p99.

Maya R: customer `acme-enterprises` opened support ticket #32489. SLA risk. Oncall: can we flip heuristic back to prefer sdpa when seq>2048 until root cause?

Jak O: I'll do a targeted rollback on the heuristic for the canary pool `gpu-canary-1`. running:
`rbctl set-flag rollout/2026-03-flashopt heuristic_threshold=9999 --env canary` (temp)

eng-bot: Incident created INC-2026-542. Pager notified.

Alex P: also adding a temporary kernel white-list: prefer `sdpa_generic`/`legacy_flash` over `flashattn_v2` for fleets hitting >0.5% error rate. pushing policy now.

Sam K: suggest also disabling `-Oattn=flash_opt` compileflag for the recent build that landed yesterday (build 20260314.3). canary rollback in progress.

ops-bot: canary rollback completed on `gpu-canary-1` at 02:38 UTC. Observed p99 drop back to ~340ms within 3m. :tada:

Maya R: nice. next steps: collect failing kernel stack traces, run memory-check repros, open bug with FlashAttention upstream, and schedule a slower ramp after we have a fix. I'll update the ticket and post a short RCA once we have root cause.

Alex P: adding a short-term mitigation doc in runbook: /docs/runbooks/flashattn-fallback.md (internal).

Sam K: note: also saw elevated tensor core occupancy saturation on a subset of NVLink-misaligned hosts — possible hardware sensitivity. will include hwmap in bug report.

Maya R: thanks team. tagging @support to message ACME with ETA 1.5h for mitigation and rollback notes.
